verdict.rationale: Casium is a software platform with a live client portal, so AI-generated insights are a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence says the product uses AI to analyze user data. Calling itself an "intelligent platform" is vague marketing, and the case-strength review is not attributed to AI; it appears to be done by attorneys and case teams.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
